subject: Copywriting
title: The Video Sales Letter
description: One-minute skill: The Video Sales Letter.

hook.text: Video sales letters convert 80% better than text-only pages for some products. The camera does what words alone cannot.

buildup.text: Jon Benson pioneered the VSL format: a narrated slide presentation that follows the classic sales letter structure.

discovery.text: VSLs work because they control the pace. Unlike text, where readers skip ahead, video forces sequential consumption.

twist.text: Many VSLs hide the buy button until the pitch is complete. Controversial, but the data shows it increases conversions.

climax.text: The VSL proved that the sales letter principle is medium-agnostic. The format adapts; the psychology stays constant.

punchline.text: Video, text, or audio. The sales letter adapts to any format.

quiz.question: Why do video sales letters sometimes hide the buy button?
options: It forces viewers to watch the full pitch, increasing conversions

details.summary: The video sales letter combines the proven structure of a written sales letter with the emotional power of video. Pioneered in the early 2010s, VSLs use narration over simple slides to deliver long-form sales messages that viewers watch for 20 to 60 minutes.
details.whyItMatters: VSLs merged two powerful mediums — written persuasion and video engagement — into a format that dominated digital marketing for over a decade. Understanding their structure helps writers create compelling video scripts that convert.
takeaways: VSLs follow the same structure as written sales letters with video delivery
Simple slides with narration often outperform high-production video
Removing video controls forces linear consumption, mimicking a sales letter's flow

faq.question: Why do simple VSLs outperform expensive video productions?
faq.answer: Fancy production distracts from the message. Simple slides with narration keep focus on the words — which is where the selling happens. Production quality signals entertainment; simplicity signals information. Prospects watch information; they skip entertainment-format ads.

faq.question: How long should a VSL be?
faq.answer: Long enough to complete the persuasion arc. Most successful VSLs run 20 to 45 minutes for products priced $97 to $2,000. The buy button often doesn't appear until 15 to 20 minutes in, ensuring only engaged prospects can purchase. Length should match offer complexity.
